title: MCP protocol: how AI agents connect to any tool in 2026

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: MCP protocol is the future—unified, secure, and compatible across all AI tools by 2026.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: But MCP lacks open-source transparency, making it a closed system controlled by a few.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: MCP uses RESTful APIs and TLS 1.3 encryption, ensuring both security and interoperability.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Open protocols like gRPC and WebSockets evolve faster with community input, not corporate control.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Protocol-driven systems are more adaptable and future-proof than any closed standard.
